verdict.rationale: Calendly documents an official MCP server that turns natural-language commands into Calendly API calls, uses Dynamic Client Registration for OAuth, and has a supported-tools list that includes creating event types. A probe confirmed the MCP docs page is live, and an agent-oriented Scheduling API guide covers end-to-end booking plus availability lookup for event types. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and explicit evidence that the MCP tool list itself exposes availability and booking reads (shown here only via the REST API docs).
